sloka: दितिम् यत्र तपः सिद्धाम् एवम् परिचचार सः ।इक्ष्वाकोस्तु नरव्याघ्र पुत्रः परम धार्मिकः ॥१-४७-११॥
transliteration: ditim yatra tapaḥ siddhām evam paricacāra saḥ ।ikṣvākostu naravyāghra putraḥ parama dhārmikaḥ ॥1-47-11॥

translations.english: "O Tiger among men (Rama) this highly virtuous and wellknown son named Vishala was born to Ikshvakus in Alambusa. Where, a city named Vishala was built.
